about.zh: 模型：读入上下文，给出一个动作
about.en: Model: reads a context, gives one action

about.zh: 拼接：至多三段上下文按顺序接成一段
about.en: Concat: up to three contexts joined in order

shared.zh: 读文件：设置里选的文件，或模型要的那个
shared.en: Read: the file its setting names, or the one the model asks for

shared.zh: 目录：模型要目录时，列出仓库的文件和函数
shared.en: File list: the repository’s files and functions, when the model asks

shared.zh: 运行测试：模型说做完或要求测试时，给出报告和是否通过
shared.en: Run tests: a report and whether they pass, when the model says done or asks

shared.zh: 纸笔：还没有机器，玩家自己当循环
shared.en: Pen and paper: no machine yet, the player is the loop

about.zh: 模型一次能读的 token 数
about.en: the tokens the model reads at once

shared.zh: 一问一答：板跑一遍，模型只调用一次，不能要东西
shared.en: One call: the board runs once, the model is called once and cannot ask for anything

shared.zh: 循环：每轮跑一遍板，直到停下或轮数用完
shared.en: The loop: the board runs every turn, until it stops or the turns run out

shared.zh: 手动：玩家放文件、调用模型、跑测试
shared.en: By hand: the player adds files, calls the model, runs the tests

about.zh: 机器：拼一块板，机器按它的方式跑
about.en: Machine: a board, run the way its machine runs

about.zh: 把仓库里的一个文件放进上下文
about.en: put a file of the repository into the context

about.zh: 把仓库的目录放进上下文
about.en: put the repository’s file list into the context

about.zh: 把上下文里的第 n 条移出（从 0 数）
about.en: take entry n out of the context (from 0)

about.zh: 运行测试，报告放进上下文
about.en: run the tests, the report into the context

shared.zh: 这款游戏教什么、学完能亲手做成什么，不写关卡数
shared.en: what the game teaches and what the player ends up building, not how many levels

about.zh: 每种机器的窗口和轮数

shared.zh: 文件路径 → 它占的 token 和它的段（函数）
shared.en: a file’s path → its tokens and its segments (functions)

about.zh: issue 里贴出全文的文件
about.en: files whose code the issue quotes in full
the issue only describes a symptom

shared.zh: issue 的文字透露了多少：文件和函数、只有函数、只有症状
shared.en: what the issue’s text gives away: the file and function, the function only, only the symptom

shared.zh: 模型第一次会写错，看到这一处失败的报告才改对
shared.en: the model gets it wrong first, right once a failing report on it is in view

shared.zh: 新元件第一次出现时只放它一个也算一关：为什么
shared.en: a new part may have a level that only places it: why

shared.zh: 任务的 id：整款游戏里唯一，玩家存下的板跟着它走（只有一个任务的关通常就用关的 id）
shared.en: the task’s id, unique in the game; what a player keeps of it goes by it (a level’s one task usually has the level’s id)

shared.zh: 这个任务的名字，写在任务条上（一关只有一个任务时不显示）
shared.en: the task’s name on the strip of tasks (not shown when the level has one task)

about.zh: 模型一次能读的 token 数
about.en: the tokens the model reads at once

shared.zh: 模型一次写完所有它知道的（once），还是会回头要东西（loop）
shared.en: whether the model writes all it knows at once (once) or asks back (loop)

shared.zh: 和 issue 一起给的代码（代码元件）
shared.en: the code that comes with the issue (the code card)

shared.zh: 参考解：一串操作，最后一次测试通过
shared.en: the reference: moves ending in a green test run

about.zh: 一块板的蓝图文本，每行一个字符串
about.en: a board as blueprint text, one string a line

about.zh: 一块板的蓝图文本，每行一个字符串
about.en: a board as blueprint text, one string a line

shared.zh: 依次做的任务，最后一个通过就通过这一关
shared.en: the tasks done in turn; passing the last passes the level
